info.title: AgentCI control API
info.description: Single-repository PR review and authenticated exact-identity semantic/eval evidence. M2 comparison reads are additive; no multi-tenant hosting claim.

post.description: Verify HMAC SHA-256 over exact raw body bytes. The X-GitHub-Delivery UUID is the idempotency key; conflicting event/body reuse returns 409. Accept only the configured installation/repository. Record unsupported events as ignored. At most 1 MiB. 202 means durably received, not reviewed. GitHub payload schema is provider-owned; pull_request events require number, action and base/head commit identities.

400.description: Invalid JSON, headers or PR payload

405.description: Method not allowed; Allow header advertises the supported method

200.description: Immutable evidence in configured repository; digest hashes canonical JSON analysis with recursively sorted object keys.

405.description: Method not allowed; Allow header advertises the supported method

get.description: Authenticated, scoped read of planned units and retained normalized results. Authorization precedes UUID lookup. No snapshots, scripts, leases or credentials are returned. At most 4 MiB; oversized evidence returns explicit 413 rather than truncation or a passing summary. UUID path spellings are case-insensitive; resource IDs are returned in canonical database spelling. Evidence payloads and digest validation are not rewritten to match the request spelling.

200.description: Consistent comparison snapshot; digest binds this exact snapshot. Results are immutable, but execution/cancellation may change the snapshot digest.

404.description: Unknown comparison within this deployment scope

413.description: Comparison exceeds the 4 MiB response budget

get.description: Single repeatable-read snapshot as LF-delimited hash-chained frames. Ordered header, grouped units and derived comparisons, summary, terminal end. Each frame at most 64 MiB. One group retained in memory; no whole-response limit. No resume cursor: restart the entire GET after a failed/incomplete stream. HTTP 200 headers alone do not certify completion. Verify terminal chain/counts and EOF before accepting final summary. UUID path spellings are case-insensitive; resource IDs are returned in canonical database spelling. Evidence payloads and digest validation are not rewritten to match the request spelling.

200.description: NDJSON frames conform to EvalExportFrame. Only verified terminal completion certifies traversal.

application/x-ndjson.example: Each LF-delimited JSON object conforms to components.schemas.EvalExportFrame

404.description: Unknown comparison within this deployment scope

Retry-After.description: Present on export-concurrency overload; delay in seconds
